title: New feature: Keep the predicted blood glucose curve onscreen and unchanged once an input has been added
symptom: When inputting an insulin dose or carbs, xDrip shows a predicted blood glucose curve that updates with each new data point, making it difficult to compare the actual glucose response to the initial prediction and identify incorrect predictive variables such as carb ratio, insulin sensitivity, or carb absorption rate.
evidence_quote: This initial predictive 'simulation' curve is updated for each data point received from that point onwards. This doesn't give you an easy picture to see where your predictive variables are incorrect.
